snippet.title: ♾️Infinity Nikki Version 2.2 PV | Chromatic Beings Everbright
snippet.description:
♾️Infinity Nikki Version 2.2 PV | Chromatic Beings Everbright
 
Fortune's draw unfolds myriad forms, where trees bloom, and fish-dragons dance through the nights.
The crescent moon pines away in its imperfection, silently bearing witness to joys and griefs alike.
Yet as the glowing dusk fades, the world emerges, vivid and radiant, alive with boundless colors.
 
Infinity Nikki Version 2.2 "Chromatic Beings Everbright" goes live on January 29 (UTC-7)!
The "Where Wanxiang Weaves Life" exclusive quest will open, along with the brand-new Wanxiang Realm! Unlock new abilities to aid your adventures, try new gameplay features like "Floating Flavors, Flowing Time" and "Fortune Mahjong," and don't miss the upcoming Dunhuang collab event "Colors Etched in Time." Stylists, get ready to dive in!

—— 
➤ Infinity Nikki Version 2.2 Chromatic Beings Everbright launches globally on January 29 (UTC-7)!
